question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **alternative**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alternative **means a choice or option that can be used instead of another. (एक विकल्प या विकल्प जिसका उपयोग दूसरे के स्थान पर किया जा सकता है)

 
 
• For example- *I don't like coffee, so I'll have tea as an alternative.*
 
 
 
• It is a noun that can also be used as an adjective.
 
• By using "alternative" the sentence emphasizes that the writer thoroughly examined various possibilities and carefully evaluated their merits.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 4**.

Complete paragraph: *I went on (1) steadily__ trying to 'find out how to'; but I wrote two or three novels without feeling that I had made __(2) much__ progress. It was not until I wrote 'Ethan Frome' that I suddenly felt the artisan's full __(3) control __of his implements. When 'Ethan Frome' first appeared, I was __(4) severely__ criticised by the reviewers for what was considered the clumsy structure of the tale. I had pondered long on this structure, had felt its peculiar difficulties, and possible awkwardness, but could think of no *__*(5) *__***__alternative__ ****which would serve as well in the given case: and though I am far from thinking 'Ethan Frome' is my best novel, and am bored and even exasperated when I am told that it is, I am still sure that its structure is not its weak point.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Adjudication **means the process of making a formal judgment or decision. (औपचारिक निर्णय या निर्णय लेने की प्रक्रिया)
 
• **Adulteration **means the act of adding impurities or inferior substances to something, usually food or drink. (किसी चीज़, आमतौर पर भोजन या पेय में अशुद्धियाँ या घटिया पदार्थ मिलाने की क्रिया)
 
• **Alternate **means to take turns or switch back and forth between two things. (दो चीजों के बीच बारी-बारी से आगे-पीछे होना)
